description: This source file contains unit testing classes for the Orleans grain directory relational storage layer across different databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL). It includes setup, teardown, and test methods for registration, unregistration, lookup, bulk unregister, and concurrency testing of grain activation entries.

classes.name: SqlServerRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Unit test class targeting SQL Server relational storage layer for Orleans grain directory.

classes.name: PostgreSqlRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Unit test class targeting PostgreSQL relational storage layer for Orleans grain directory.

classes.name: MySqlRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Unit test class targeting MySQL relational storage layer for Orleans grain directory.

classes.name: RelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing common setup and test methods for Orleans grain directory relational storage layer tests across multiple databases.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment by creating storage and query instances based on the database invariant.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources asynchronously after tests.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_RegistersActivation
methods.description: Tests registering a grain activation into storage.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_LooksUpActivation
methods.description: Tests looking up a registered grain activation.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_UnregistersActivationsForSilos
methods.description: Tests bulk unregistering of grain activations for specified silos.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_ChaosTest
methods.description: Concurrent test simulating high-load operations to detect database deadlocks or concurrency issues.
